mapper.select: SELECT transaction.id, transaction.ref, transaction.posted_label, transaction.entity_name, transaction.client_name, transaction.account_code, transaction.category, transaction.amount, lower(transaction.direction) AS type, lower(transaction.status) AS status, transaction.method, transaction.requires_dual_sign, transaction.approved, tag.tag FROM ledger_transaction transaction LEFT JOIN ledger_transaction_tag tag ON tag.transaction_id = transaction.id WHERE (#{entity} = '' OR transaction.entity_name = #{entity}) AND (#{client} = '' OR transaction.client_name = #{client}) AND (#{accountCode} = '' OR transaction.account_code = #{accountCode}) AND ( #{tag} = '' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ledger_transaction_tag match WHERE match.transaction_id = transaction.id AND match.tag = #{tag} ) ) AND ( #{query} = '' OR lower(transaction.ref) LIKE lower(concat('%', #{query}, '%')) OR lower(transaction.client_name) LIKE lower(concat('%', #{query}, '%')) OR lower(transaction.entity_name) LIKE lower(concat('%', #{query}, '%')) OR lower(transaction.category) LIKE lower(concat('%', #{query}, '%')) ) ORDER BY transaction.created_at DESC, tag.tag_order ASC
SELECT transaction.account_code, transaction.category, lower(transaction.direction) AS direction, transaction.amount FROM ledger_transaction transaction
